A pneumothorax occurs when air gets into the space between the chest wall and the lung. This air pressure pushes against the lung tissue, causing it to collapse.
Atelectasis occurs when part of the lung stops working properly. Air is trapped in the small pockets that are normally emptied when you exhale. This trapped air decreases the amount of oxygen in the part of the lung affected by atelectasis.
